desc:
"Come be My Friend!

Jump near a wall to walljump, jump in the air to longjump

! There are still relatively many bugs !

SAY MY NAME is a ASYMMETRICAL Survival Game, Inspired by Bear Alpha. Fun Time ahead!
Made with love by @hazerred, @dshan1202alt, @Finschee, @devxtheno, @stubsusername, @catsush and our wonderful testers

Be a Friend, and try to catch your New Friends! Use Your Abilities to your Advantage, and show Off your new skin!
Or Be yourself and try to survive with your Colleagues! Use super Cool Gears to fend off Friend.
Very Original Gameplay Much! :-)

PLAY NOW! FRIENDS AND JOY AHEAD.
